_meta.method: Platform page-fetch tool, one read per URL, no login, no access control used or bypassed. Each of the five canonical listing pages was read and its page title and category breadcrumb compared word for word with the stored record. Prices, star ratings and review counts were visible on the pages and were deliberately NOT copied (F-02). Only observations of text already stored were made; no specification value was added, inferred or changed.
_meta.scope: The five published product listings (P1-P5). The two official policy pages were not re-read in this pass.
not_done: Associates Central: no account access in this sandbox, so no tag registration, one-link test or tracking-report check (F-57, F-58). No test is claimed complete.
The five supplied link.amazon short links were not re-resolved; the 2026-11-19 resolution records in data/intent-links.json stand unchanged.

Item-details tables (brand, model, dimensions, capacity) were not reached in the retrievable chunks for P1-P3, and are not populated for P4/P5 in this read either, so capacity, dimensions and model_number stay blank for the thermometers (F-60).
No price, rating, review count, commission rate, traffic figure or revenue figure was read into any register.
Search Console, the analytics endpoint and reader capture were not exercised; none is connected (F-59, F-61).
_meta.purpose: Fresh line-by-line re-verification supporting D-54/F-95: the site's own catalogue counts were corrected, so the five records those counts describe were re-confirmed against their official listings in the same session.
